headerDisplay:
Control charging on an Alfen Eve wallbox from HomeKit.

**Before you start:** run `npm run probe -- --host <ip> --password <password>` to confirm the charger answers.

**Important:** the charger allows a single API session. While this plugin is polling, the Eve Connect app cannot log in. Use the **Connected** switch in the Home app to hand the session over: off for your phone, on for HomeKit control.
footerDisplay:
There is no real stop command on the Alfen API. The plugin pauses charging by setting the socket current limit (parameter `2129_0`) to 0 A, which is below the 6 A minimum the pilot signal needs, and resumes it by setting the limit back to your configured charge power.

The charger stores this limit in amps, so the kW you enter is converted using the phase count it reports (`312E_0`) at 230 V. 3.7 kW is 16 A on one phase.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

host.title: Charger IP address
host.description: The charger's IP address or hostname on your LAN. Do not include https://.

password.title: Charger password
password.description: The admin password for the charger's local API - the same one the Eve Connect app uses.

chargePower.title: Charge power (kW)
chargePower.description: Charge rate applied when the Charging switch is turned on, in kW - the same figure the Eve Connect app shows on its Maximum Power slider. The plugin converts it to amps using the number of phases the charger reports. Single phase: 1.4-7.4 kW. Three phase: 4.1-22 kW.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the charger. Lower values mean faster updates but more load; the charger is known to be unhappy when polled hard.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log every request and state change. The password is never logged.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: How long to wait for a single API call before giving up.

powerThreshold.title: In-use power threshold (W)
powerThreshold.description: Power above which the Charge Point outlet reports as in use.

certificateFingerprint.title: Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256)
certificateFingerprint.description: Optional. Pin the charger's self-signed certificate. Leave empty to trust the first certificate seen. The probe script prints this value.

nominalVoltage.title: Nominal voltage (V)
nominalVoltage.description: Voltage used to convert kW to amps. Only change this if your grid voltage differs markedly from 230 V.
